title: Ulyana and the Protocol
author: Freya Galloway
blurb: Hazel Galloway, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
